_**User**_

@engineering-frontend-developer

Every metric card and KPI across the entire dashboard needs a tooltip that 
explains what it means and why it matters. This is for an ops team that is 
not technical.

Create a reusable Tooltip component:
- Small info icon (ⓘ) next to every metric label
- On hover: shows a clean popover with title + explanation text
- Popover should not get cut off at screen edges (position smart)
- Subtle, non-intrusive — doesn't clutter the UI
- Works on both desktop hover and mobile tap

Create a constants file: lib/kpiDefinitions.ts
Define tooltip text for every KPI in the dashboard. Examples:

OVERVIEW:
- Total Cases: "Total new child cases registered in Unity during this period. 
  Each case represents a unique child being onboarded to a centre."
- Assessments Added: "Number of assessments assigned to clinicians. A single 
  child can have multiple assessments across different tools (SPM, DP3, REELS, 
  ISAA)."
- Results Generated: "Assessments where the clinician has completed scoring 
  and the system generated a result. This is the core clinical output."
- Completion Rate: "Percentage of assigned assessments that have a generated 
  result. Low rate = clinicians have pending work or are blocked."
- Resets: "An assessment that was reset means the clinician's work was undone 
  and they had to start again. High resets indicate data entry errors or 
  clinician training gaps."
- Transfers: "Assessment transferred from one clinician to another. Could 
  indicate workload balancing or clinician unavailability."

CLINICIANS:
- Active Caseload: "Number of cases currently assigned to this clinician that 
  are not yet closed. High caseload = risk of delays."
- Last Login: "When the clinician last logged into Unity. No login in 3+ days 
  during working week is a flag."
- Approval Lag: "Average time between clinician submitting work and manager 
  approving it. High lag = manager bottleneck."

MANAGERS:
- Cases Registered: "Number of new child cases this manager onboarded. This 
  is the entry point of the entire clinical workflow."
- Assessments Assigned: "How many assessments this manager assigned to 
  clinicians. Unassigned cases block the whole pipeline."
- Goal Approval Rate: "Percentage of goal approval requests that this manager 
  has actioned. Low rate = clinician goals are sitting unreviewed."
- Report Approval Rate: "Percentage of assessment reports approved by this 
  manager. Unapproved reports cannot be shared with families."

BOTTLENECKS:
- Avg Onboarding Turnaround: "Average hours between a case being registered 
  and the first assessment being assigned to a clinician. Should be under 48h."
- Cases Stuck in Onboarding: "Cases registered more than 48 hours ago with 
  no assessment assigned yet. These children are waiting."
- Pending Goal Approvals: "Goals submitted by clinicians awaiting manager 
  review. Goals cannot be worked on until approved."

ASSESSMENT TYPES:
- SPM: "Sensory Processing Measure — assesses sensory processing patterns. 
  Typically completed in 1-2 sessions."
- DP3: "Developmental Profile 3 — comprehensive developmental assessment. 
  More complex, typically takes longer."
- REELS: "Receptive-Expressive Emergent Language Scale — language development 
  assessment for young children."
- ISAA: "Indian Scale for Assessment of Autism — autism screening tool. 
  Complex, multi-session assessment."

Add more tooltip definitions for any other KPIs in the dashboard that 
don't have one. Every single metric that shows a number should have a tooltip.

This is a modern AI-era product. The tooltip design should feel polished — 
clean card with slight shadow, proper font sizing, max-width so text doesn't 
sprawl. Smooth fade-in animation. The info icon should be subtle but 
discoverable.

Check and follow any rules in .cursor/rules/

## UI Implementation — KPI Tooltips

**New files created:**

- `frontend/components/shared/KpiTooltip.tsx` — Reusable tooltip component
- `frontend/lib/kpiDefinitions.ts` — 40+ KPI definitions covering every metric on the dashboard

---

### KpiTooltip component

**Design:**
- SVG info circle icon (12×12px) in `text-gray-300`, brightens to `text-gray-500` on hover — subtle but discoverable
- `cursor: help` to telegraph interactivity without cluttering
- Popover is a clean white card: `rounded-xl`, layered shadow (`0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.11)`), `border border-gray-100`, 280px max-width — text never sprawls
- Bold 11px title, relaxed 11.5px description in gray-500

**Smart positioning:**
- Uses `createPortal` to render into `document.body`, so it can never be clipped by `overflow: hidden` parents
- `computePosition()` checks space above vs. below the trigger at render time, and clamps horizontally with 8px viewport margins

**Interaction model:**
- Desktop: `mouseenter` / `mouseleave` with a 90ms debounce timer — moving the mouse from the icon to the popover keeps it open
- Keyboard: `focus` / `blur` — fully keyboard accessible with `aria-label`, `role="tooltip"`, and `aria-describedby`
- Mobile: tap to toggle; outside `pointerdown` listener closes it
- `useId()` generates stable ARIA IDs with no collisions across multiple tooltips on the same page

**Animation:** `kpiTooltipFadeIn` keyframe (opacity 0→1 + 4px translateY lift) over 130ms, defined globally in `globals.css`
